name: Othiel
title: Keeper of the Keeping
examine: The smallest bank in the world, kept perfectly. Two vaults, one chest, and a keeper who does not count out loud, because counting out loud is for people who might be wrong.
lines: What is kept is kept. That is the whole charter, and it has never needed a second line.
The Charter's countinghouse has nine clerks and a tithe vault. We have a bench and my memory. Same service.
Your coin is safe here. Safer than you are, frankly, but you chose the adventuring.
